{{Quote|We are all tremendously excited about the upcoming attack. The Rebels main base has been discovered on the ice planet Hoth. A huge assault force is being sent to destroy it. '''Alpha 2''' was the callsign of a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Alpha 2 participated in a [[Battle of Remitik|battle]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Remitik]] against forces of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that were retreating from the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The engagement was the pilot's first combat experience.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Alpha 2 is the name of the player character in the [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter demo|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' demo version]]. The documentation provided with the demo established additional details about the pilot.
